en.html:
GHQ Lieutenant"Gone?"
Wolf"........................"
GHQ Lieutenant"P-Professor? They've gone. The Forged Bomb and the Silver Star, both."
Wolf"No."
GHQ Lieutenant"Eh?"
Wolf"Not gone. They have become a minute black point."
Wolf"Gravity was raised beyond the limit. They collapsed in on themselves..."
GHQ Lieutenant"..."
GHQ Lieutenant"D-does that mean... we failed?"
Wolf"No."
Wolf"Success."
Wolf"That black point is a vortex of gravity. It falls toward THE CENTRE OF THE EARTH!!"

en.html:
Wolf"This light... water carrying God's life..."
Wolf"The very element of tsurugi."
Wolf"...Oh... Everything, like crystal..."
Wolf"...METAL crystal!"
Wolf"No tsurugi-forging process... Just bathe in this concentrated water of light... and like this... become purely a part of God."
Wolf"Agape! God's love, binding everything together!"
Wolf"So it WAS..."
Wolf"This was the truth of Kristallnacht. The Night of Crystal."
Wolf"My wise Great Law-Head, Adolf... You were right to see a revelation from God in it."
Wolf"I was right to believe you."
Wolf"My dream... my hypothesis of God... was RIGHT."
